title: Chapter 1076
text:
The secondary dimension was a bizarre world made up of a variety of planes. Many secondary dimensions had very different physical laws from the main universe, and most of them were not suitable for living creatures in the main universe. Some were naturally formed, while others were created from the imagination of advanced mages.

The main universe was like the branches and roots of a tree, while these secondary dimensions were like leaves and fruits. There was a nutrient (energy) connection between them.

The researchers in the universe had created a worldview model for the secondary dimensions. It was like a world with countless bubbles stacked on top of each other. Each bubble represented a secondary dimension, and the space walls were much weaker than the main universe.

The advanced civilizations had always been keen on exploring the secondary dimensions. Not only could they obtain special resources, but they could also develop various new technologies by studying the phenomena of different secondary dimensions. The three Universal Civilizations' research results in this area were very fruitful, and their technological strength in the universe largely came from this.

Therefore, the three Universal Civilizations had set up a large number of outposts, research stations, and collection stations in the secondary dimensions, as well as stationed armies to protect the scholars and workers. Most of the time, they were dealing with the attacks of secondary dimension creatures.

Outpost A000 was the dynasty's largest secondary dimension military camp, set up in a secondary dimension suitable for survival. The dynasty's exploration of this place had already been completed, and they had completely controlled and transformed this secondary dimension. They hoarded a large number of troops and used it as the dynasty's headquarters in the secondary dimension, acting as the gateway for the dynasty to enter the secondary dimension world.

As soon as Clottey stepped into this place, a magnificent scene jumped into his eyes.

This secondary dimension separated the heavens and the earth, and the reddish-brown land extended all the way to the end of his vision without any bends. The continuous dynasty bases were located here, like a forest made of steel, and there was no end in sight.

There were no stars in the sky, only gradually changing colors, like the blood-red clouds when the sun set. Magnificent rays of light flowed in the sky like the wind and clouds, forming a fog-like scene, forming different shapes. At the same time, in the distant sky, there seemed to be some kind of invisible light source hanging, forming the Tyndall effect, emitting a misty and dreamy light path.

Clottey was very familiar with this dreamy scene, but he had not seen it for many years. At this time, he could not help but stop and admire it.

At this moment, a thunderous and forthright laughter suddenly rang out in the surrounding space.

"Hahaha, Clottey, you're finally on holiday?"

Hardly had he concluded his sentence when a bolt of blue and green lightning darted out of the ground bases and stopped in front of Clottey in the blink of an eye, revealing a brawny figure wearing the uniform of a senior general of the Imperium.

Seeing this person, the usually serious Clottey couldn't help but reveal a faint smile.

"Guzar, long time no see."

"Haha, I didn't expect you to come looking for me as soon as you're on vacation. You're indeed a good brother!" The burly figure laughed.

This person was a hybrid of the dynasty's human race and the Silvers, but he did not have much of the elegance of the Silvers. He had a rough and masculine appearance, with a wild beard and braided hair. If Han Xiao was there, he would definitely mistake him for Zhang Fei.

'Thunder' Guzar, a direct Beyond Grade A of the dynasty, an Esper with the ability to control plasma electricity. He was the guardian of the secondary dimension army all year round.

The two of them had similar qualifications. Clottey and Guzar had joined the army less than five years apart. They had known each other since they were weak and had always had a good relationship.

Clottey shook his head. "I'm not here on vacation this time. I have a mission."

"No wonder you're not the Ruler's Guard for the time being." Guzar nodded and curiously asked, "Is this a secret order from the Ruler? What does she want you to do?"

"Hunting Beyond Grade As. The first target is the guy hiding in the secondary dimension called Traveler. He's suspected to have participated in the war in the Flickering World not long ago. You know about that, right?"

"Haha, of course I know. There's no entertainment here, but I watch the dynasty's news every day. I heard that Black Star defeated twelve Beyond Grade As, including Kasuyi and Sierron. How powerful. I really want to spar with such a strong person, but it's a pity I haven't seen him with my own eyes."

Guzar's tone was filled with regret. He was guarding the secondary dimension and could not leave his post.

"There will be a chance in the future," Clottey comforted.

Guzar did not hesitate and smiled. "Black Star is a great lad. When you retire, he'll probably be the one to replace you."

"It's a pity he's not a direct member of the dynasty." Clottey did not comment and changed the topic. "The secondary dimension is your territory. I need your help to track Traveler."

"No problem." A cold light flashed in Guzar's eyes. "In recent years, there have been more and more rats hiding in the secondary dimension. It's time to teach them a lesson."

…

In a certain secondary dimension, Traveler was flying like a meteor wrapped in magic light.

Suddenly, his speed came to a halt, and a hesitant look appeared on his face.

"Strange, why do I suddenly feel uneasy …"

Mages would not ignore their intuition. Traveler stopped, took out a crystal ball, and cast a divination spell.

He held the crystal ball with both hands, and specks of light floated out from his palms and merged into the crystal ball. Soon, the crystal ball rippled, and an image appeared.

Clottey's face quickly appeared and disappeared.

"The Dark Emperor? Why would he have a relationship with me? "

Traveler's expression changed slightly.

His actions during the rescue of Hella had only been pretending to spar and indirectly put pressure on them. He had not directly participated in the siege.

In his opinion, even if the Black Star Corps was suspicious of him, as long as he hid in the secondary dimension, the other party would not waste their energy to make a big fuss. However, he did not expect the dynasty to bring out the Dark Emperor. It felt like killing a chicken with a butcher's knife. In front of the Dark Emperor, he had to admit that he was a chicken.

"If I meet the Dark Emperor, I definitely won't be his match."

Traveler's mood was solemn. Even if he had mastered Evil Convergence, he did not think that he would be able to defeat the Dark Emperor. That was a peak Beyond Grade A who could control dark energy and dark matter. Even [Golden Ring] Oulou, who had once controlled secondary dimensions, was defeated by the Dark Emperor. He did not think that he was stronger than Oulou.

After thinking for a while, Traveler's eyes flashed.

"Now that I've shown Evil Convergence, the dynasty will definitely use this as a clue and track me down. If I don't appear, they'll definitely do something to Evil Convergence. Looks like I can only find some helpers to ambush the Dark Emperor."

He had not stayed in the secondary dimension for so many years for nothing. Not only did he maintain a good relationship with some powerful creatures in the secondary dimension, but he also knew many Beyond Grade As who stayed in the secondary dimension.

Some of them were not even on the list of Beyond Grade As recorded in the main universe!

…

On the other side, in a hidden secondary dimension, a teleportation gate suddenly appeared, and a few small battleships flew out. Their outer armor did not have any organization insignia, and their models were top-notch high-warp speed spaceships. They were equipped with a full set of secondary dimension navigation components, so they looked a little heavy and bloated.

In the command room of the main ship, many operators were focused on their work. Everyone was wearing a full set of mechanical suits, so their appearances could not be seen.

In front of the porthole, two figures stood. They were wearing a hood and a long robe. Their faces were covered with special equipment, and only the difference in their physiques could be seen. It was a man and a woman. The man was short and stocky, while the woman was tall and slender.

These two were the commanders of this trip. They belonged to the same organization and had a special mission on their shoulders.

"Your Excellency Law, Your Excellency Fay, we have arrived at our destination. Please instruct us on the next step," an operator who looked like an officer reported to the two of them.

These two people were called 'Law' and 'Fay'. These were not their real names but their code names in the organization.

The short and stocky man was Law. He nodded and slowly said, "Follow the plan. Divination shows that Black Star will bring the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy into the secondary dimension soon. Activate all the life form detection radars in the secondary dimension secret strongholds. Increase the detection range to the maximum, and set the target's life form strength to peak Beyond Grade A."

Fay's cold voice also sounded at this time. "The secondary dimension is our home ground. Our mission is to seize the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. Black Star is very strong, so we need to avoid a direct confrontation. The leader has asked us to bring many technological products, which will be enough to trap Black Star for the time being. "

Then, she paused and added, "If we use conventional methods, we won't be able to detect him.

"If we can't find it with conventional detection methods, the leader will allow us to use the Destiny's Child Esper Ability Form once."

…

In the actual combat training room of Black Star Palace, Han Xiao called Ames to his room.

"Busy man, you finally have time?" Ames raised her eyebrows and said with a teasing tone.

"I'm busy with work, so I can't help it." Han Xiao laughed, took out a compressed orb, and tossed it to Ames. "This is a special mechanical suit suitable for survival in secondary dimensions. I built it myself. Try it on."

Buzz!

With a burst of Mechanical Force, the compressed orb expanded and turned into a black mechanical suit, which clung to Ames's body. It was light and tight.

She moved around a little, and her movements were not sluggish or uncomfortable. She clicked her tongue and said, "It fits very well. Looks like you know my body very well. You're very observant."

That's because I touched it before … Han Xiao coughed.

Furthermore, it clearly has the nano-transformation function, so it can fit perfectly no matter what body type it is. What's there to be surprised about?

While complaining in his mind, his hands were not slow either. He summoned the modified Mysterious Energy.

"Black Star, are you ready to go?" Seeing this, the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy became excited and could not wait to meet up with his old friend.

Han Xiao nodded and explained to Ames, "The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy has the ability to travel through secondary dimensions. With him leading the way, we can save a lot of energy."

Among the five major class systems, only Mages and Mechanics could enter and exit the secondary dimensions stably. They used different technology systems to enter the secondary dimensions.

Espers were a random factor. In comparison, the dimensional travel ability of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was more convenient, and they even needed its help to find the Holy Light Particle.

This was not the first time Ames had gone to a secondary dimension. The normal process was very troublesome, but with the help of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy and Black Star, things were much simpler. She could not help but ask, "Then, where are we going first?"

"The dynasty has many outposts in the secondary dimensions, but I don't want to disturb them. Since you also have the Void bloodline, let's enter through the Void Dimension."

Han Xiao grabbed the Mysterious Energy Host's arm and gestured for Ames to do the same.

"Okay." Ames did not object, but she did not grab the Mysterious Energy Host. Instead, she placed her hand on Han Xiao's shoulder.

Normal people would have to make sufficient preparations when going to a secondary dimension, but the two of them were Beyond Grade As, so they did not need to prepare anything. It was a trip, so they had to have the feeling of going as they pleased.

The next moment, the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy activated its ability. Red energy gushed out and covered the two of them along their arms.

Swoosh!

With a flash of light, the three of them disappeared.

…

Their vision blurred slightly, and the scene before them changed drastically. They were no longer in Black Star Palace but in the familiar Void Dimension.

"That was fast." Ames was shocked.

"This is an ability it was born with. To it, returning to a secondary dimension is like returning home. It's as easy as a fish in water." Han Xiao smiled.

The Mysterious Energy Host's combat strength was not bad, and at the same time, it had many convenient Esper Abilities. It was truly a useful tool.

Ames took a deep breath of Void Energy, feeling the excitement in her cells. She was in a much better mood. She chuckled and said, "Do you have any travel plans?"

"Let's get down to business first. We'll have plenty of time to walk around afterward."

After Han Xiao said that, he turned around and knocked on the Mysterious Energy Host.

"Do you know what the secondary dimension where the Holy Light Particle is called?"

"I don't know what you call it in the outside world, but I recognize its energy fluctuation, so I can track it," the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy explained.

Hearing this, Han Xiao nodded. He had checked the dynasty's exploration records of secondary dimensions based on the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy's description, but he did not find any similar secondary dimensions. This meant that the location of the Holy Light Particle should not have been discovered yet.

It made sense. If the Holy Light Particle's nest was destroyed by an advanced civilization, it would not be able to comfortably stay at home. Thus, they could only rely on the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy to lead the way.

"Let's go, let's go. I can't wait to teach it a lesson."

The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was eager to give it a try. It could not control the carrier by itself and needed Han Xiao's approval.

Hearing this, Han Xiao could not help but laugh. The Holy Light Particle probably had the intention of tearing apart its old friend.

So, you're the one who lured the enemy here?

Shaking his head with a smile, Han Xiao was about to speak when his expression suddenly changed.

Rumble —

At this moment, the Void Energy around them suddenly went berserk.

Ames also sensed it. She narrowed her eyes, looked into the distance, and said in a low voice, "That's right.

"Something seems to be coming!"

—

(Introduction: The story of a demon king from another world that came out and asked the protagonist to modify its attributes. In the end, it was tamed by love and justice.)
